title: Duplicate Nodes

story.briefing: Two nodes on this bus are claiming the same address. With a hundred thousand nodes on the line, the operators gave up looking by hand.
story.success: Collision confirmed. The bus arbitrator can finally do its job.

description: Given an array of node addresses, return true if any address appears more than once, and false if every address is unique. An empty array returns false.
hints: The question is only ever "have I seen this before?". Some structures answer that in constant time; a plain array does not.
Comparing every address against every other one is correct but does roughly n squared comparisons. At three hundred thousand addresses that is far too slow — the hidden tests will time out.
Walk the array once, keeping a set of addresses already seen. If the current address is already in the set, return true immediately. Otherwise add it and continue. Return false at the end.
